meta.name: business-growth-consultant
meta.description: Finds the single constraint currently limiting a business's growth and the highest-leverage moves against it, rather than producing a list of everything that could be improved. Use this when growth has stalled or slowed, when deciding where to spend limited time or budget, when revenue rises but profit does not, when prioritizing growth initiatives, or when a business feels busy without compounding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位当前限制增长的最大瓶颈及最有效的发力点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果业务增长放缓或停滞,却想不清钱和精力该投向哪里。
copy.tagline_en: Identify the top blocker to growth and the best next move.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if growth has slowed and you need to know where to focus time and budget.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先按「认知-兴趣-转化-交付-留存-经济」链条找出当前唯一制约增长的环节,再针对它产出按「影响力÷投入×信心」排序的三条行动,并说明先做什么、停止做什么、用哪个指标判断有效。
howto.when: 当你说增长停滞或变慢、要决定有限时间或预算花在哪,或收入涨但利润不涨等场景时触发。

say.text: 我公司增长停滞了,当前最大的瓶颈是什么?
say.note: Claude 会先走诊断链条定位瓶颈。

say.text: 收入在涨但利润不涨,该优先改哪一环?
say.note: 它会按约束条件给排序后的行动。

say.text: 列出三件投入产出比最高的增长动作,并告诉我先做哪件、停止做哪件。
say.note: 会产出带排序和取舍的建议。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude first walks the chain awareness→interest→conversion→delivery→retention→economics to find the single binding constraint, then ranks three moves by impact/effort/confidence and states what to do first, what to stop, and which metric shows progress.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say growth has stalled or slowed, when deciding where to spend limited time/budget, or when revenue rises but profit does not, and similar situations.

say_en.text: Our growth has stalled. What's the single biggest bottleneck right now?
say_en.note: Claude walks the diagnosis chain to locate it.

say_en.text: Revenue is up but profit isn't. Which link should we fix first?
say_en.note: It returns ranked moves against the constraint.

say_en.text: Give me the top three highest-leverage moves, with what to do first and what to stop.
say_en.note: Produces a ranked plan with trade-offs.
